data.text: Glad we could all meet before heading out. My family’s fished this lake for years, and I want it to keep supporting our village. With 100 tons in the lake, we can each catch 10 tons this month, leaving 50 to double back to 100. That’s $10,000 each, month after month, if we stick to it. I propose we agree to that limit and check our catches together each month. John, what do you think?
